# Richard Tirta

> Senior frontend engineer in San Francisco specializing in AI-native and
> data-heavy user interfaces. React/TypeScript/Next.js. Apple (contract),
> Meta, AKQA. Has shipped frontend against MCP integration boundaries in an
> enterprise AI platform and builds LLM-powered products end to end. This
> repo is the canonical public context about him; his working repositories
> are private by design.
